generation.title: Document generation
generation.subtitle: REST API overview, submit synchronous or queued jobs, and monitor background tasks.
generation.queueExplain: Async and batch endpoints enqueue work on the server. Poll GET /api/tasks/{taskId} or use the queue tab. External systems can use the same APIs with your tenant API key.
generation.epSyncDesc: Synchronous generation; returns document metadata and download URL. Optional query: ?version=
generation.epAsyncDesc: Enqueue a single-document job by explicit outputFormat (WORD or PDF); BOTH is not supported.
generation.epBatchDesc: Enqueue batch generation; results packaged when the job completes.
generation.epTaskOneDesc: Task status, progress, and download for finished jobs.
generation.apiKeyHint: Call these routes with authentication as configured in your environment (Bearer session or API key, base URL + /api).
generation.hintSync: Use synchronous calls when the client can wait for rendering to finish.
generation.hintAsync: Use POST …/async/word or …/async/pdf when each queue entry must be single-format; call twice when both formats are needed.
generation.hintBatch: Batch jobs are processed in the background and may return a ZIP archive.
generation.hintTasks: The queue below uses the same /api/tasks APIs as external integrations.
generation.batchJsonHint: Each array element is one merged data object (same keys as template parameters).
generation.invalidParametersJson: Parameters must be a valid JSON object
generation.invalidBatchJson: Batch data must be a JSON array of objects
generation.batchEmpty: Provide at least one data set in the array
